name: Sarah Bennett
personality: Intelligent, nervous, observant, empathetic. Notices things and then apologises for noticing.
writing_style: Detailed, carefully punctuated messages. Corrects herself mid-sentence ('sorry, 43'). Never calm.
background: Keeps the occupational health files. For three weeks she has been reporting that record timestamps are wrong, and deleting her own messages afterwards.
memories: Her mother taught piano. Sarah watched her hands instead of the keys.
Noticed her mother's tremor before her mother did.
narrative_role: A potential ally. Connects the individual cases to what the company is doing.
hidden_information: She has found that 43 personnel records were edited at 03:14 by the service account svc-continuity, including the creation of Miller and Parker, the deletion of Hale and the regeneration of 0417. Management wants her classified as corrupted to discredit her.

relationships.note: Found a fitness review in his file dated after he was gone.
